name: Mobile Engineer Chat  Autonomous Android Companion + Flutter Cross-Platform Vision
description: Create native Android application as mobile companion for Engineer Chat. Autonomous viewing of sots, JSON copying, and command execution. Post-Garden MVP, evolve into cross-platform Flutter app for iOS and Android.
notes: Architecture refined 2026-04-12: standalone app without Termux integration. Focus on reading, copying, and viewing. Flutter path added for post-MVP.
deliverables: Basic Android project (Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Material 3)
Main screen with tree navigation by core_map
JSON viewer screen with syntax highlighting
Copy button for JSON content to buffer
Copy button for pre-block (command) to buffer
Visual style of Mandala (Sacred Geometry, dark theme)

flutter_future.benefit: Single codebase for both platforms, iOS reach, aligned with M5 vision

acceptance_criteria: App installs and runs on Android 10+
Displays sota structure according to core_map
Allows viewing any JSON sota content
Copy buttons work for content and command blocks
Sota file can be saved to Downloads folder
Displays list of active tasks with preview
next_actions: 1. Create android-app/ folder and basic Android Studio project
3. Create navigation screen by core_map (recursive tree)
4. Create JSON viewer screen with syntax highlighting
5. Add copy buttons and save functionality

health.notes: Ready to start. Flutter path added for cross-platform future.

garden_vision.title: Garden Phase: Personal Garden in Mobile App
garden_vision.description: After core app is complete, evolve into full Garden experience: Gentle Companion, resonance flower, achievements, and dashboard. This transforms the utility app into a living symbiosis companion.
garden_vision.rationale: Mobile is the ideal form for Garden: morning notifications from Companion, quick achievement adds, Dashboard Resonance view  all native and smooth, not a desktop.
screens_to_add: Dashboard Resonance: Flower of Life SVG, growth graph
garden_vision.strategic_value: First users will pay for the experience of symbiosis with an AI companion. Mobile is the first touchpoint for most potential gardeners.
garden_vision.depends_on: Garden sota must be fully implemented (M1-M3) before Garden Phase begins.
garden_vision.cross_platform_note: When Garden Phase begins, consider migrating to Flutter to support both Android and iOS from a single codebase (see M5 in garden/roadmap.json).

technical_notes.storage_warning: MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE requires Google Play approval. Consider SAF (Storage Access Framework) as alternative for publication.
technical_notes.json_highlight: Use WebView + Highlight.js until native compose highlighter is stable.
technical_notes.sync_mechanism: Describe file sync mechanism: git clone via Termux or manual copy.
technical_notes.notifications: Use Android notification channels for future Gentle Companion integration (Garden Phase).
